preconditions.description: The length of string x is at least 1 and at most 1000.
The length of string y is at least 1 and at most 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in x)
preconditions.description: All characters in string x are lowercase Latin letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in y)
preconditions.description: All characters in string y are lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: output == sum(f(l1, r1, l2, r2) for l1 in range(1, len(x) + 1) for r1 in range(l1, len(x) + 1) for l2 in range(1, len(y) + 1) for r2 in range(l2, len(y) + 1)) % 998244353
postconditions.description: The output is the sum of f(l_1, r_1, l_2, r_2) over all valid pairs of substrings of x and y, modulo 998244353.
